nodes.name: Quinta Vale da Lama
nodes.purpose: Vale da Lama is a regenerative organic farm and intentional community in Odiáxere, Lagos, SW Algarve, Portugal. The farm hosts agrotourism stays, educational events, volunteer programs, and partner organisations focused on regenerative agriculture, food sovereignty, ecosystem restoration, and community resilience. nodes.name: Casa Vale da Lama
